skill.description: Guides digital pathology workflows for slide inspection, tissue masking, tile extraction, preprocessing, visualization, and dataset preparation with histolab.

content.value_statement: Whole slide images are too large for standard image workflows. This skill guides histolab-based masking, tile extraction, preprocessing, and visualization.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to load SVS, TIFF, and NDPI slides and inspect dimensions, magnification, metadata, and pyramid levels.
Guides tissue mask selection and customization with TissueMask, BiggestTissueBoxMask, BinaryMask, and composed filters.
Configures RandomTiler, GridTiler, and ScoreTiler for sampling, coverage, or quality-based tile selection.
Builds preprocessing pipelines with thresholding, contrast, color conversion, and morphological filters.
Provides visualization workflows for thumbnails, masks, tile locations, mosaics, score distributions, and reports.
Outlines reproducible multi-slide processing with fixed seeds, consistent resolution, structured outputs, and quality checks.
limitations: Requires users to install histolab and its native image dependencies.
Does not execute workflows or verify results without local slide files and a configured Python environment.
Does not replace pathologist review, clinical validation, or regulatory approval.
Large slides can require substantial memory, storage, and processing time.

use_cases.title: Explore tissue regions
use_cases.description: Inspect slide properties, preview tissue masks, and sample representative tiles before detailed analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare training datasets
use_cases.description: Extract reproducible random, grid, or scored tiles with consistent quality thresholds.

use_cases.title: Standardize slide processing
use_cases.description: Apply consistent masks, filters, naming, and reports across a slide collection.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one slide
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the whole slide image at [slide path]. Report its dimensions, magnification, pyramid levels, and a safe preview workflow before extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Preview tissue and tiles
prompt_templates.prompt: For [slide path], recommend a tissue mask and RandomTiler settings for [goal]. Include thumbnail, mask, and tile-location previews.

prompt_templates.title: Build a dataset workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible histolab workflow for [slide directory]. Use [tile size], [pyramid level], and [tissue threshold], with quality checks and reports.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a custom pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my histolab workflow for [stain and artifact conditions]. Propose composed filters, mask selection, tiler strategy, performance controls, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Plan a random sampling workflow for one H&E slide.
output: Load the slide and inspect its dimensions, magnification, and available pyramid levels.
Preview a TissueMask on the thumbnail and adjust thresholds when valid tissue is excluded.
Use RandomTiler with a fixed seed, then preview locations before extracting the requested tiles.

output_examples.input: Choose a tiler for complete tissue coverage.
output_examples.output: Use GridTiler with a validated tissue mask. Set tile size, pyramid level, overlap, and tissue threshold before previewing the grid.

output_examples.input: Troubleshoot a workflow that extracts no tiles.
output: Confirm that the slide thumbnail contains tissue and the extraction mask covers it.
Lower the tissue threshold and verify that tile size matches the selected pyramid level.
Preview tile locations after each change before starting extraction.

best_practices: Preview thumbnails, masks, and tile locations before writing large outputs.
Fix random seeds, extraction levels, tile sizes, and thresholds for reproducibility.
Validate masks and tile quality across representative slides before batch processing.
anti_patterns: Do not extract an entire slide collection before validating one representative slide.
Do not assume one tissue threshold works across stains, scanners, and preparation quality.
Do not use generated outputs for clinical decisions without expert review and validation.

faq.question: Which slide formats are covered?
faq.answer: The guidance covers common OpenSlide-compatible formats, including SVS, TIFF, and NDPI. Actual support depends on installed image libraries.

faq.question: How do I choose a tiler?
faq.answer: Use RandomTiler for sampling, GridTiler for coverage, and ScoreTiler for ranked selection.

faq.question: Which tissue mask should I use?
faq.answer: Use TissueMask for multiple regions and BiggestTissueBoxMask for one dominant region. Validate either mask visually.

faq.question: Does this skill process slides automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides Python workflows, but execution requires local files, histolab, and compatible native dependencies.

faq.question: Can outputs support clinical decisions?
faq.answer: No. Outputs require pathologist review, clinical validation, and applicable regulatory controls before clinical use.

faq.question: How can I reduce processing time?
faq.answer: Start with thumbnails and a small tile count. Choose a lower-resolution pyramid level, then batch only validated settings.
